literal_meaning: আমড়া কাঠ দিয়ে তৈরি ঢেঁকি (a pounding mortar made from mango wood)
similar_in_english: Useless as a screen door on a submarine
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো আমড়া কাঠের ঢেঁকি, কোনো কাজেই আসে না।
এই যন্ত্রটা আমড়া কাঠের ঢেঁকির মতো, একদম অকেজো।
example_sentences_in_english: He is like a mango wood mortar, completely useless in any task.
This machine is as worthless as a mango wood mortar, totally ineffective.
note: Refers to the softness and ineffectiveness of mango wood for making durable tools like a rice-pounding mortar, common in Bengali agrarian society.
